description: Chabad of Lamorinda is a warm, welcoming Jewish center in Lafayette, California, serving Lafayette, Moraga and Orinda with Shabbat and holiday services, a Jewish preschool, Hebrew school, classes and community events. No membership required.

shabbatText:
## Shabbat dinner with the Rabbi's family
Rabbi Yisroel and Tzipora Labkowski and their family host Shabbat dinners: a traditional Friday night meal with Jewish songs, warm conversation and a festive table. It is a wonderful way to get to know the Rabbi and Rebbetzin. You are welcome any week of the year; please let us know you are coming at 925-384-7242 or through [contact](/contact).

## Sponsor a Kiddush
Celebrating a birthday, anniversary or yahrzeit? [Sponsor a Kiddush](/kiddush/) and share the occasion with the whole community.
